_note: Copy to config.json and edit. Keys starting with _ are comments. Amounts are in units of the loan asset.

chain.name: HyperEVM
chain._rpc_note: Needs an archive RPC: 7-day yields read state from a block 7 days ago.
chain._blocks_note: Rough guess used to find the block 7 days ago; yields are annualised with the real block timestamps.

yields._note: Reference yields that borrowing is compared against (usually the LST you loop). 7-day change of an exchange rate, annualised.

stHYPE._note: stHYPE per wstHYPE, read as the two balances of one wallet that holds both

alerts._note: Alert when borrow rate >= 24h median + spike_pts, or > the reference yield for hold_min minutes. Re-alert when it rises another escalate_pts. 'Back to normal' when below the yield and below median + spike_pts/2.

markets.name: Felix kHYPE/WHYPE
markets._hold_note: Morpho rates drift slowly around the target; this one sits near the kHYPE yield half the time, so a short hold spams.

markets.name: Felix wstHYPE/WHYPE
markets._market_note: A prefix is enough; the full id is looked up in the Morpho API.

digest._note: Daily digest: top supply venues (7-day share-price APY after fees) and top loops (profit per year at the best size).

telegram._note: Bot token comes from env TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN only. chat_id/thread_id here or in env TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID / TELEGRAM_THREAD_ID.
